description: Cheapest Wizzair fare per day around a date (fare chart, ±day_interval days — up to a 19-day window). Returns one price per day in the route's local currency, plus return-leg days when return_date is set, and a wizzair.com fare-finder link. Data comes live from Wizzair's private booking API (unofficial — may briefly fail if Wizzair rotates or throttles it). Use wizzair_search_timetable for departure times, wizzair_search_flight_dates for operating days.

arrival_station.description: Arrival airport IATA code (3-letter, e.g. BCN).

date.description: Center date of the window, YYYY-MM-DD.

day_interval.description: Days around the date to include (±N). Default 9; Wizzair's minimum is 3 — lower values are bumped.

departure_station.description: Departure airport IATA code (3-letter, e.g. WAW).

no_cache.description: Force a fresh Wizzair fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

return_date.description: Return-leg center date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for one-way.

wdc.description: Price with the Wizz Discount Club (WDC) membership discount. Default false.

name: wizzair_search_fares
title: Wizzair fares around a date
